entries.4675149692d4acdc: This is the single segment of hotel management and hotel-related operations, running two hotels in Kyoto City. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,772 million; by department, accommodation was ¥4,249 million, banquets ¥2,890 million, restaurants ¥2,103 million and other ¥528 million.
entries.6556c2247832e388: A hotel company founded in 1888, operating "Hotel Okura Kyoto" and "Karasuma Kyoto Hotel" in Kyoto City.
entries.7a0611595b139b4c: It is a company headquartered in Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto City, that operates hotels on a stand-alone basis with no consolidated subsidiaries. As of March 31, 2026, it had 364 employees, and its shares are listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Hotel Okura Co., Ltd., an other affiliated company, holds 35.3% of the voting rights.
